blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines— The Office of the Solicitor General (OSG) has petitioned for the cancellation of the birth certificate of mining tycoon Joseph Sy amid allegations that he falsified his Filipino citizenship. It was the head of the Philippine Statistics Authority’s (PSA) legal service, Atty Eliezer Ambatali, who mentioned the case filed by the OSG during the hearing of the Senate subcommittee on justice and human rights on Thursday. “…As of now, the OSG has already filed the case for the petition for the cancellation of birth records of Joseph Sy. So na-file na po ito, Your Honor,” Ambatali said, responding to Sen. Risa Hontiveros’ queries. […]... Keep on reading: OSG seeking cancellation of Joseph Sy's birth certificate – PSA
